title.zh: 授权Marcelina S. Aquino将其依第697、757号共和国法在武端市及阿古桑省各市镇与市镇区安装、运营、维护电话系统特许权转让、让与、出售、抵押给银行或金融机构的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing Marcelina S. Aquino to Transfer, Assign, Sell or Mortgage in Favor of Any Banking or Financing Institution Her Franchises Under Republic Acts Numbered Six Hundred Ninety-Seven and Seven Hundred Fifty-Seven, to Install, Operate and Maintain Telephone Systems in the City of Butuan and in the Province of Agusan and the Municipalities and Municipal Districts Thereof

text.en: Subject to the provisions of the Constitution, Marcelina S. Aquino is hereby authorized to transfer, assign, sell or mortgage in favor of any banking or financing institution the franchises granted under Republic Acts Numbered Six hundred ninety-seven and Seven hundred fifty-seven, which were transferred to her by authority of Republic Acts Numbered Thirty-nine hundred seventy-one and Thirty-nine hundred seventy-two, as well as the certificates of public convenience granted or to be granted by the Public Service Commission to her pursuant to the above-mentioned Acts, including all assets and property operated thereunder, located in the City of Butuan and in the Province of Agusan and the municipalities and mu­nicipal districts thereof.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, June 21, 1969.
